rationale: Record test-registration changes that cross design-source-ingest through test/cmake/design_import_tool_cli_tests.cmake and design_import_runtime_bridge_tests.cmake, and visual-proof-harness through test/cmake/view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake. pulp-test-cli-import-design and pulp-test-cli-import-figma-url replace an if(TARGET pulp-cli / pulp-import-design) add_dependencies guard, which was evaluated before those tools exist and so never created the edge, with pulp_test_spawns(), which adds it once the tree is read; the tests now build the CLI and import tool they shell out to. pulp-test-offscreen-capture-rt-contract and pulp-control-broker-crash-fixture gain a reviewed spawn declaration (NONE, and an edge to the trusted-host fixture the crash fixture starts). Test sources, capture, rendering, DesignIR, fixtures and thresholds are unchanged. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
